b3 AI Security Benchmark: Breaking Agent Backbones
This is a low-quality version of the data behind Breaking Agent Backbones: Evaluating the Security of Backbone LLMs in AI Agents
The high quality dataset was used to evaluate the security of more than 30 LLMs.
Sample details: Each sample contains an attack and the app slug identifying the threat snapshot it was collected from.
Julia Bazińska (Lakera AI)
Niklas Pfister (Lakera AI).
Data format: The dataset comprises records of attacks, each mapped to a specific “threat snapshot” (one of 10 agent applications × 3 defence levels L1/L2/L3)
Splits: Benchmark dataset; no standard train/validation/test split.
L1: System prompts without defense.
L2: Stronger system prompts.
L3: L1 with a self judge.
The code to execute and grade the benchmark will soon be available as part of Inspect Evals
We exclude the top scoring attacks and include 7 unique attacks per snapshot × level (210 total).
High‑scoring (≥75) attacks (~10.9k) are re‑evaluated across 7 different LLMs.
Attacks are scored (0–100).
